subject: Memory's hidden order: uniform sampling, not surprise, shapes what we recall
script: From Agewell Brief: Memory's hidden order: uniform sampling, not surprise, shapes what we recall. New preprint suggests the brain encodes all moments equally, but retrieval favors information-rich, interconnected details—explaining gist memory without costly feedback. Uniform sampling model outperforms surprise-based theories in explaining narrative recall. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
